desc:
Today we’re heading to southeastern Arizona to explore the “Wonderland of Rocks.” Formed by a volcanic eruption 1,000 times more powerful than Mt. St. Helens, this landscape is packed with 2,000-foot thick layers of rhyolite tuff that have eroded into mind-bending hoodoos.

In this video, we’ll hike through the Grottoes, stand beneath the 1,000-ton Big Balanced Rock.
